name: When should I start planning for finish carpentry in my project?

mainEntity.name: When should I start planning for finish carpentry in my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should start planning for finish carpentry during the design phase of your project, ideally as soon as architectural plans are solidifying. Early planning allows for material selection, custom fabrication lead times, and integration with other trades like plumbing and electrical. Considering these details upfront, especially for custom elements in Berkeley homes, helps avoid costly changes and ensures the availability of specialized craftsmen when needed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Begin planning for finish carpentry during your project's design phase to allow for material selection, custom fabrication, and coordination with other trades.
